pull: GET /api/v1/shop Bearer → validate → replace exact (store_id, unicid)
push: signed inbound shop_cache POST validates and replaces the same record without calling CP
display_allowed: last-known validated snapshot while TTL not expired

stale_grace_after_ttl.recommendation: No extra grace after TTL. Display uses last-known only while expires_at is in the future. Side-effecting order submission requires a fresh validated snapshot or fails safely.
